summary: Patch adds samesite to delete_cookie's set_cookie call, resolving reported issue that deleted cookies lost SameSite/Secure semantics; matches Django's actual accepted approach for this ticket.

issues.description: delete_cookie() has no samesite parameter of its own, so it always uses SESSION_COOKIE_SAMESITE regardless of what samesite value the cookie being deleted originally had (e.g., cookies unrelated to sessions, like CSRF or custom app cookies with a different SameSite policy).

Tying delete_cookie's samesite for any cookie to the SESSION_COOKIE_SAMESITE setting is a naming/semantic stretch since delete_cookie is a general-purpose method, not session-specific, though this matches the documented tradeoff Django accepted for this fix.
